source_result_unit.atomic_score: One exported backward-model Pearson r per released participant ID, recording modality and ICA condition.
source_result_unit.original_grouping: Six modality-by-ICA source groups, each containing20 participant-score rows. Grouping alone does not specify an inferential endpoint.
source_result_unit.reported_group_statistic_or_contrast: Unresolved: recover the exact original reported statistic, contrast and reduction before defining any comparison target.
source_result_unit.independent_unit: Participant, pending recording identity join; not a participant-condition row or a time sample.

mandatory_support.coverage_requirement: Retain all original participant-condition rows and their grouping for cohort checks, faithful reduction and paired uncertainty. These rows are not automatically independent tests or improvement objectives.

comparison_mapping.row_role: Audit and uncertainty support; not pointwise improvement constraints.
comparison_mapping.target_rule: Recover and use the exact original reported group statistics or contrasts, their numerical references and source reduction. Do not replace them with an invented aggregate.
explicitly_not_adopted: No requirement that every participant-condition r must improve or be nonregressing.
No pooled120-row mean or win-count objective.
No inference that20 released numeric IDs have already been joined to20 independent recording identities.

source_protocol_preserved: 20-person simultaneous Salzburg M/EEG/ECG cohort, original modality channels and ECG-informed ICA, 100-Hz sampling, four-fold nested temporal CV, -250 to250-ms integration window and50-ms Hamming basis. Preserve all six conditions and preprocessing ECG exposure.
recovery_required_before_any_executable_: Recover exact author-reported group statistics or paired contrasts for Figure3C,D; source distributions alone do not identify an aggregate objective.
Recover temporal-fold-to-r reduction, original confidence-interval/test procedure and participant pairing.
Join the120 source rows to original recordings, channels, splits and complete population support.
Bind the appropriate published and replayed author reference to those exact recovered endpoints.
Explicitly declare justified reproduction tolerances, meaningful gains and source-aligned inferential/admission rules; do not derive them from convenient rounding or imported descriptive means.
